generalInfo.generalRule: Whether you prefer a beautiful buffet dinner with seasonal fare, a picnic on the Russ and Wendy Palmer Great Lawn, or delicious, freshly-prepared casual food and drink on your way to your seat, the Mann offers a variety of dining and drink options. Restrictions are indicated at the bottom of all event pages. One 20-oz bottle of water per person is permitted for all concerts. Photography of any kind is prohibited during orchestra performances. Patrons found possessing professional equipment not expressly authorized will be asked to check their cameras at Visitors' Services or will be escorted off campus. events.info: Featured in Time Out New York, and the the New York Comedy Festival, Tight Pants Comedy is the only show where national headliners join gritty local favorites on stage to trim the extra fabric, and perform their tightest sets with rapid-fire jokes. Aside from the tight sets, the name Tight Pants plays on the fact that the producers of the show, Kyle Wayne and John Bennett are both millennials who enjoy swearing skinny jeans?a wardrobe item Gen Z has proclaimed ?uncool?. November?s show at Punch Line will also be a co-production with Ten Comedy, produced by Brad Rickert and Sheri Ciprane. The first Ten Comedy Show took place in 2014 in Chicago, but has since moved to Flophouse Comedy Club in Brooklyn. Sheri and Brad are also the co-produers and hosts of the Pimp Daddy Podcast.

boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Located directly at the Box Office. The original purchaser must bring their credit card and a valid form of identification in order to pick up their tickets. We do not accept any incoming will-call.

venues.parkingDetail: There is very limited street parking. Parking lots are located behind the venue. Please allow yourself time to park prior to the event. Lot N: 49 Richmond Street, Philadelphia, PA 19123 Lot S: 1025 N. Front Street, Philadelphia, PA 19123

generalInfo.generalRule: Patrons must be ages 21 and older. Legal photo I.D. is required. There is a 2 drink minimum per person. Camera Policy: Personal cameras are allowed in the venue. Flash photography, video and removable lens cameras are not permitted without venue approval. Smoking is NOT permitted inside the building.
